questions.stem: A student removes oxygen from around the roots of a plant and notices that mineral ion uptake decreases significantly. What explains this result?

options.text: Without oxygen, the cell membranes become fully permeable and minerals leak out
Without oxygen, osmosis cannot occur so water stops entering the roots
Without oxygen, the root hair cells cannot carry out photosynthesis to produce minerals
Without oxygen, aerobic respiration cannot produce ATP, so active transport of mineral ions slows down

questions.explanation: Mineral ions are absorbed by root hair cells via active transport, which requires ATP from aerobic respiration. Without oxygen, aerobic respiration cannot occur, so less ATP is available, and the rate of active transport decreases significantly.
